description: Figure 6 (left) is a pie chart titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," which illustrates the proportion of data from various sources used in the combined training set. The largest segment, representing 31.3%, is from the NQ dataset, colored blue. The second largest segment, at 16.1%, is from the FEVER dataset, colored light green. The third largest segment, at 15.4%, is from the SNLI dataset, colored orange. The remaining segments are: VITAMINC at 13.0% (light blue), MULTINLI at 11.3% (red), SCITAIL at 1.2% (dark green), PUBHEALTH at 0.5% (light green), MULTIFC at 0.5% (dark green), XSUMHUL at 1.6% (light blue), ANLI at 4.6% (yellow), FACTCC at 2.6% (light green), ENTF at 1.8% (light green), and SCIFACT at 0.1% (dark green). Each segment is labeled with the dataset name and its corresponding percentage.
